description: Render a URL or a raw HTML string to a PDF in headless Chromium (print-quality, selectable text). Options: paper format (A4, Letter, Legal, A3, A5, Tabloid), landscape, print backgrounds, margins, and scale. Returns a short-lived download URL (valid 1 hour) with byte size, page count and SHA-256; set includeBase64 for the PDF inline (up to 3 MB). Raw HTML up to 2 MB; any external resources it loads go through the same private-address block. Pure rendering, no AI.

html.description: Raw HTML document to render instead of a URL (max 2 MB)

includeBase64.description: Also return the PDF as base64 in the response (default false; omitted if over 3 MB)

margin.description: CSS margin applied to all sides, e.g. '1cm', '0.5in', '10mm' (default '1cm')

printBackground.description: Include CSS backgrounds and colors (default true)

url.description: Page to render (provide url OR html)

waitUntil.description: When loading counts as finished (default load)

name: html_to_pdf
title: HTML to PDF
